name: Initiative for Cyber Security Information Sharing Partnership of Japan
description: Founded October 25, 2011. Public-private cyber threat-intelligence sharing partnership centered on critical-infrastructure equipment manufacturers; run alongside the related J-CRAT rescue/advice program.
relationToCloudSecurity: See registry/control/ipa.go.jp.json in the SecID repo (CloudSecurityAlliance/SecID) for cloud/AI security relevance notes on this source.
relationToAISecurity: See the paired SecID registry entry.

license.notes: Published by a quasi-public body (specially-approved corporation / public-interest incorporated foundation) rather than a national government organ directly -- the Copyright Act Article 13 government-notification exclusion may not extend cleanly to this publisher. Freely readable public web content; citation/reference use is reasonable, but full redistribution status is unconfirmed. Hosted publicly under the 4-tier hosting rule regardless of licence: IPA, an incorporated administrative agency under Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, publishes it on its government website (ipa.go.jp) with no login (Tier 1; see `tier_evidence`). The redistribution and derivatives fields still record that IPA's own terms are unconfirmed.

tier_evidence.note: Public HTML page on ipa.go.jp, no login; the overview text is in the page.

current_extraction.notes: The single English-language overview page was captured in full (this is genuinely all the English documentation that exists -- detailed annual reports and SIG lists are Japanese-only and were not pursued further given time constraints).
